facts.business: Key Corp Limited is a registered NBFC engaged in vehicle financing, particularly old vehicle finance, and investment of surplus funds in mutual funds, with operations concentrated in Uttar Pradesh.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Title deeds of immovable property held in erstwhile name 'Key Leasing and Finance Limited'; overdue amounts exceeding 90 days of Rs 12.07 lakhs classified as NPA with adequate provision made.

key_risks: High-risk nature of vehicle financing, particularly in northern region
Severe competition from organized banking sector, especially private sector banks
Market risks associated with investment of surplus funds in mutual funds
facts.related_party_note: No significant transaction of material nature with related parties during the year; provisions of Section 188 of Companies Act, 2013 not attracted (subject to Note No. 25 of Annual Accounts).
